text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Good morning, Master. I was reminiscing 
about my experiences over the break.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Actually, I went for a light jog that 
doubled as maintenance, however...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
At the park, I encountered a mammalian 
creature of the order Carnivora out on a 
walk... In other words, a 'dog.'

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps recognizing me as an ally since I 
always accompany Master, it made contact 
and refused to let go—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
As a result, I thoroughly enjoyed that 
fluffy fur. Thanks to this, both mind and 
body were successfully rested.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"...That was truly magnificent fluffiness. 
Just remembering it... makes my heart feel 
fluffy too."

Experiencing animal therapy during her 
vacation, she seems to have refreshed both 
body and mind!
